# Louis Sader

> DevOps Software Developer building cloud and AI infrastructure. AWS Solutions Architect Associate and CompTIA Security+ certified. Former NCAA distance runner.

## About
Louis Sader is a DevOps Software Developer based in New England. He builds cloud and AI infrastructure with AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Roger Williams University, with minors in Mathematics and Data Science.

## Current work
- DevOps Software Developer at Solid State Scientific Corporation (Nashua, NH), since February 2026.
- Co-Founder and Full-Stack Developer at Oryx Technologies LLC, a New England web studio. Active clients: The Spot Nashua, VixFix Pro, Santella Designs.

## Certifications (earned)
- CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701), earned May 2026.
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate (SAA-C03), earned April 2026.
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02), valid 2025 to 2028.

## Skills
DevOps, AWS, cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
